lesson.subtitle: Lesson 13 -- Getting Around
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 13 -- Getting Around
lesson.grammar_point: imperatives for directions (turn, go straight, take, get off, don't)

listenings.text: Welcome aboard. This is a Brooklyn-bound F train. The next stop is Forty-Second Street, Bryant Park. Please stand clear of the closing doors. For the seven train, get off at the next stop and follow the signs. If you are going to York Street, stay on this train for six more stops. Please do not lean on the doors. Thank you for riding with us.

Hi Rodrigo, it is Nora. Here are the directions to our office for Monday. From your hotel, walk to the corner and turn right on Lexington Avenue. Go straight for three blocks. At the traffic light, cross the street. Our building is the tall glass one, number four twenty. Do not go to the main entrance. Use the door on Forty-Fourth Street, and take the elevator to the twelfth floor. I am there from eight thirty. See you on Monday.

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo left the hotel and asked a woman for directions. She told him to go straight for two blocks. At the traffic light he turned left and saw the park. After the meeting he took the subway to Brooklyn. He got off at York Street and walked to the river.
